# WellMindAI

> WellMindAI is an AI-powered mental health companion providing 24/7 empathetic support, emotional validation and evidence-based clinical screening (DSM-5, ICD-11, PHQ-9, GAD-7, PCL-5) through text chat, voice therapy and video sessions — in English, Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil, Bengali, Marathi and Spanish.

WellMindAI is built for anyone carrying grief, anxiety, burnout, loneliness or an ordinary heavy day. Two AI counselors — **Yaro** (calm, grounded) and **Ava** (soft, warm) — listen without judgement, remember context across conversations, and route to human crisis support when needed. Chat is free with no signup; voice and video plans start at ₹99/week.

## Core Features

- [Chat with Yaro](https://www.wellmindai.in/chat/yaro): Free, no-signup multilingual chat therapy with real-time CBT/DBT grounding and silent PHQ-9 / GAD-7 pattern analysis.
- [Voice therapy](https://www.wellmindai.in/consultation/audio): Phone-call style audio sessions with Yaro (male voice) or Ava (female voice), paced for co-regulation.
- [Video counseling](https://www.wellmindai.in/consultation/video): Face-to-face AI counseling sessions for visual grounding.
- [Journal](https://www.wellmindai.in/journal): Mood tracking, streaks and guided reflective prompts.
- [Self help](https://www.wellmindai.in/self-help): CBT, DBT and ACT exercises plus curated mental-health resources.

## Clinical Safety

WellMindAI is a support companion, not a replacement for emergency care. Crisis language triggers an immediate de-escalation protocol and routes users to local helplines — Tele-MANAS 14416, iCall 9152987821, Vandrevala 1860-266-2345 (India) and 988 (US). Screening scores are indicative signals shared with the user, never a diagnosis.
